units.note: Unlock at TH 11 with Barbarian level 8. Super Troop levels follow Barbarian levels. Research costs and times below upgrade the base troop, not the Super Troop separately. Boosting costs 25,000 Dark Elixir or one Super Potion for 3 days. Normal self-training caps exclude event-only levels, donations, and temporary boosts.
